title: Events and lifting state
summary: Move a value that two components need up to the parent that contains them, pass it down as a prop, and pass a function down so that a child can ask for a change. You will watch the inspector's flow view draw each click as event, callback prop, setter, and re-render, and add a product to a list in the parent from a child form.
changeNote: Corrected the reference to the Fall week where we first handled DOM events.
